response.sql: WITH long_rentals AS (SELECT rating, rental_rate, rental_duration FROM film WHERE rental_duration > 5), rating_averages AS (SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) as avg_rate_per_duration, COUNT(*) as film_count FROM long_rentals GROUP BY rating), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(avg_rate_per_duration) as benchmark_value FROM rating_averages) SELECT ra.rating, ra.avg_rate_per_duration, ra.film_count, ra.avg_rate_per_duration / b.benchmark_value FROM rating_averages ra CROSS JOIN benchmark b WHERE b.benchmark_value IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ra.rating
